title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering

Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

Meet The Guru

Resource Guru is a blissfully simple scheduling tool that helps busy teams stay on track.

â­ï¸ The role

Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.

As more teams use Resource Guru and as we continue to support larger, more complex customers we want to make sure every customer receives fast, clear, thoughtful and genuinely helpful support.

This role is primarily about helping customers by email, understanding their questions, troubleshooting issues, and making sure they get the best possible experience from Resource Guru.

Youâll work closely with Dana, our Senior Customer Support Specialist, and collaborate with our product and engineering teams when customer questions, bugs or feature requests need to be investigated further. We see Customer Support as a core part of building a great product, so youâll work closely with the rest of the team to help improve Resource Guru, not just answer support tickets.

What Youâll Be Doing

Learning Resource Guru inside out

  • In your first few months, you'll get to know Resource Guru inside out - how customers use the product, what common questions come up, and how to guide people towards the right answer.

Responding to customer questions

  • Help customers with day-to-day support questions, including product usage, account setup, billing enquiries, troubleshooting and general "how do Iâ¦?" queries.

Troubleshooting problems

  • Investigate customer issues carefully and methodically - asking the right follow-up questions, checking account settings, trying to reproduce a problem, looking for browser-related issues, or escalating a bug to engineering with clear notes.

  • Work closely with Dana and the wider Resource Guru team to understand customer questions, resolve issues, and make sure useful feedback is shared with Product and Engineering.

Improving our help content

Using our support tools

Helping customers feel looked after

title: GTM DACH
description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free and told a colleague. The market is open and the clinicians in it already like the product. Your job is to turn those smaller scale use cases into enterprise deals.

You're the first line to Heidi in DACH. Inbound demand connects you with practices, MVZs and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out or close it yourself. Where the signals run thin, you build the outbound.

For most clinicians you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. You'll both triage inbound to your Account Executive where it belongs and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across German-speaking healthcare that outlasts the role.

What you’ll do

  • Work the inbound queue and the warm product signals across DACH. Your day goes to clinicians and practices already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version.

  • Build outbound where the signals are thin: pick the practice groups, MVZs and hospital groups worth going after and work them in German.

  • Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the practice or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the angle for each one.

  • Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh.

  • Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff.

  • Own small SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month.

  • Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get, and so the German-language product and collateral keep up with what you hear.

  • Track what's shifting in German healthcare (regulation, the practice groups, the insurers, the competitive set) and tell the team what you're hearing on the phones.

What we're looking for

  • Native or fluent German, and English that allows you to work in a global team.

  • You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, sales, creative, banking, consulting, or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than any time in a sales role.

  • You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product works than memorise a pitch.

  • You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have extremely busy schedules, you respect that and still get the meeting.

  • Knowing how German healthcare buys (who decides in a Praxis, an MVZ or a hospital group, and who pays) is a head start. If you don't know it yet, you're the type who'd learn it in your first month.

  • Organised and self-running. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

 

Attitude is more important than experience so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem solving and building relationships we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

description:

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. The Opportunity

We’ve consolidated separate compliance programs (Grammarly, Coda, Superhuman Mail, and Superhuman Go) into a single program. We’re rapidly replacing the point-in-time approaches with continuous, automated, code-defined evidence, and this role continues to build on that.

The job is to automate your way out of the manual toil: our GRC automation platform is the evidence-automation backbone, agentic systems (Claude Code and similar) are the force multiplier, and GitHub is where the program lives as code. If your instinct on seeing a manual control-testing process is to turn it into a repeatable, automated pipeline, this role is for you.

What You Will Do:

  • Automate evidence collection. Configure and operate the GRC automation platform: wire up data sources, build evidence plugins, scope data sets, author analysis rules, and stand up continuous monitoring operations, replacing screenshot-and-upload workflows with automated collectors mapped to controls.

  • Automate GRC workflows and run compliance as code. Use Claude Code (or similar) and MCPs for evidence requests, control mapping, gap analysis, vendor reviews, and reporting; build and curate the team’s agent harness; and manage policies, control definitions, and automation in GitHub through branches, pull requests, and review.

  • Design control testing and drive remediation. Instrument testing across SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, and ISO 42001 for continuous assurance rather than point-in-time snapshots, and work with control owners and engineering to close gaps with automated evidence behind every finding.

What Ramping Up Looks Like:

You will be configuring our GRC automation platform, not just clicking through it, within your first few weeks. In your first 90 days, we’d expect you to learn the platform configuration, ship your first automated evidence collectors, retire a batch of manual screenshot evidence, and get at least one agent-assisted workflow running end-to-end.

Why This Role:

  • You’ll design the automation architecture for compliance across four products, rather than maintaining an existing checklist.

  • You get the mandate and the tooling to retire manual evidence collection: a GRC automation platform, agentic AI, and compliance-as-code.

  • We actually run LLMs and AI agents in production GRC workflows today. This is how the team operates day-to-day.

  • Small team, high ownership, and a direct line to Legal and Engineering leadership. You’ll shape the program, not just sustain it.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in compliance, GRC, or IT audit, hands-on with the frameworks above (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and adjacent).

  • 1+ year using agentic AI systems (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to do real compliance work, with automation you have delivered, not just prototypes.

  • Comfortable in GitHub: repos, branches, pull requests, and code review. CI/CD familiarity is a strong plus.

  • Fast on new tooling. You can pick up a GRC automation platform and be productive in weeks, configuring it directly rather than relying on others to do so.

  • Deep GRC fluency: control design, evidence, risk, and how auditors actually think.

  • Working knowledge of cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP): IAM, compute, storage, networking, and security controls, because that’s where the evidence lives.

  • Systems thinker who prefers to automate repetitive manual work rather than repeat it.

Nice to Have:

  • Reads APIs, JSON, and logs comfortably; scripting (Python, bash, TypeScript).

  • Prior hands-on experience with a GRC automation platform (Vanta, Drata, or similar).

  • Scripting/light coding and API integration experience.

  • Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or similar.

  • AI governance, AI risk management, or ISO 42001 exposure.

  • Background in a technology, SaaS, or engineering-adjacent environment.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

     

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

title: Team Lead (m/f/d) Analytics & Forecasting
description:
Why The Mobility House?

  • Take responsibility and join us in building an emission-free world of energy and mobility.
  • Look forward to exciting tasks, plenty of scope to shape your work, and endless opportunities to grow beyond your current limits.
  • Join an open, diverse, and international team that brings together a wide range of perspectives.
  • Work or life? Have both! Flexible working hours, half a day off on both 24.12. and 31.12., and mobile work options ensure maximum flexibility. And for a change of scenery: up to 20 days of mobile work from other European countries per year.
  • Family comes first: If your child falls ill, you get up to 15 days of leave per year with full pay.
  • Choose between modern Apple or Dell equipment.
  • We subsidize your "Deutschlandticket" (Germany-wide transit pass) to make your commute easier.
  • We support your health and well-being through Wellpass, our work-life portal, and various other sports and wellness offers.
  • Plan for the future with peace of mind thanks to our company pension scheme.
  • After your probationary period, you can lease your dream car via FINN or your dream bike via JobRad.
  • An office where you’ll feel right at home: modern, well-connected, and dog-friendly-you’re welcome to bring your four-legged friend along.


What you do

We optimise and market a growing portfolio of flexible assets on European power markets - battery storage, aggregated EV fleets and renewable generation. Our multi-market optimisation and execution is purely algorithm-driven and fully automated. What decides whether we make money is the quality of the inputs our algorithms run on: forecasts of prices, market fundamentals and renewable generation - from long-term views down to intraday and real time.

  • You own the complete forecasting stack our short-term algorithmic trading desk relies on: prices (day-ahead, intraday, imbalance and ancillary services such as FCR and aFRR), fundamentals (load, residual load, cross-border flows, outages, fuel and CO₂) and renewable generation (wind and PV) and you keep short-term and long-term views consistent
  • You deliver these forecasts as production-grade, probabilistic inputs (point forecasts, quantiles and scenarios) directly into our optimisation and bidding algorithms, and own their accuracy, timeliness and availability
  • You develop and implement analytical, statistical and fundamental models to assess European power and renewable markets and deliver data-driven insights and signals for our trading decisions
  • You assess market trends and new markets quantitatively, providing the basis for country and product decisions
  • You lead a team of 5-7 analysts & data scientist, develop them technically and coach them in their personal growth
  • You work closely with Trading Desk, Portfolio Management & Pricing, Sales and Product, building the bridge to develop cutting edge products and services
  • You create reports, monitorings and benchmarks to derive actionable insights for trading, senior management and other stakeholders
  • Your models feed into bids and prices largely automatically, and into the decisions of the management board


Who you are

  • Several years of experience in quantitative analysis on European power markets — price, fundamental and renewable generation forecasting as well as fundamental modelling.
  • A solid understanding of day-ahead, intraday and ancillary services, capacity and local flexibility markets, and of how prices form in them
  • Experience in technical leadership — or a clearly visible step towards it — with the ability to motivate and develop a team
  • The ability to translate quantitative findings so that the management board and stakeholders can make decisions based on them
  • business-fluent English and German is a plus 


Are you a good fit for us?

Diversity enriches our team and makes us stronger. Regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, or any disability – everyone is welcome here! We look forward to receiving your application and achieving great things together.

title: Senior CRM Manager:in (Lifecycle & Retention) I E-Commerce I Growth I Achim, hybrid
description:
Kleines Kraftwerk & Du

Wir sind Kleines Kraftwerk, ein junges Unternehmen mit großer Ambition. 


In nur drei Jahren sind wir stark gewachsen und noch lange nicht am Ziel. Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Tempo und echter Gestaltungsspielraum – verbunden mit der Erwartung, dass du ihn nutzt.  Mit unseren Produkten bringen wir die Energie von morgen direkt zu den Menschen nach Hause. Unsere Mission ist es, nachhaltige Energie einfach, zugänglich und alltagstauglich zu machen. 


Du sorgst dafür, dass die richtige Botschaft zur richtigen Zeit bei den richtigen Kund:innen ankommt und machst sichtbar, welchen Beitrag CRM zu unserem Wachstum leistet.

Als unser:e neue:r


Senior CRM Manager:in /  Lifecycle & Retention

entwickelst du CRM bei uns von einem bislang nebenbei betriebenen Kanal zu einer echten Wachstumsfunktion. Die Basis ist da: Klaviyo, mehrere hunderttausend Leads und Kund:innen sowie jede Menge Daten. Was fehlt, ist eine klare CRM-Strategie mit intelligenter Segmentierung, automatisierten Lifecycle-Flows, strukturiertem Testing und einem Reporting, das Wirkung und Umsatzbeitrag sichtbar macht.

Du verschickst bei uns also nicht einfach Newsletter. Du gestaltest, wie wir entlang des gesamten Lifecycles Kund:innen ansprechen und langfristig binden. Dafür bekommst du echte Ownership, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance, CRM bei Kleines Kraftwerk von Grund auf zu prägen.

Bereit, aus CRM einen echten Wachstumstreiber zu machen?


Wofür du Verantwortung übernimmst



CRM lief bei uns bisher nebenbei – jetzt wollen wir daraus einen echten Wachstumstreiber machen. 

  • Du baust unsere CRM- und Lifecycle-Strategie auf: Du entwickelst Prozesse, Tools und Strukturen von Grund auf und richtest sie auf Kundenbindung und Wiederkäufe aus.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Lifecycle-Flows: In Klaviyo konzipierst und optimierst du automatisierte Customer Journeys von Welcome und Post-Purchase bis Cross-/Upselling und Win-back.
  • Du entwickelst relevante Kundensegmente: Leads und Kund:innen segmentierst du nach Kaufverhalten, Interessen und Lifecycle-Phase für eine gezielte Kundenansprache.
  • Du verantwortest unsere CRM-Kampagnen: Du steuerst Themen, Timing und Versand und stimmst dich eng mit Marketing und E-Commerce ab.
  • Du etablierst eine Test- und Lernkultur: Mit strukturierten A/B-Tests identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst unsere CRM-Maßnahmen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du steuerst die CRM-Performance: Relevante KPIs und Reportings nutzt du, um Erfolge messbar zu machen und konkrete Maßnahmen abzuleiten.
  • Du stellst Datenqualität und Compliance sicher: Du sorgst für sauberes Listenmanagement und DSGVO-konforme CRM-Prozesse.
  • Du identifizierst die größten CRM-Hebel: Potenziale priorisierst du nach Business Impact und entwickelst perspektivisch weitere Retention-Programme wie Loyalty und Referral.


Womit du punkten kannst

Du kennst CRM nicht nur aus der Theorie. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing mit und weißt, wie aus Kundendaten relevante Kommunikation und messbare Kundenbindung entsteht. Dabei wartest du nicht auf Vorgaben, sondern erkennst Potenziale und setzt sie eigenständig um.

  • Du kennst CRM aus der Praxis: Du bringst ca. 4+ Jahre Erfahrung mit, idealerweise im E-Commerce- oder D2C-Umfeld, und hast eine CRM-Funktion bereits aufgebaut oder maßgeblich weiterentwickelt.
  • Du beherrschst Klaviyo: Flows, Segmentierung, Templates und Testing gehören für dich zum Tagesgeschäft und auch mit großen Kontaktdatenbanken arbeitest du sicher.
  • Du denkst datengetrieben: Du verstehst relevante CRM-KPIs, erkennst Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Kundenbindung und Umsatz ab.
  • Du behältst den Überblick und setzt Prioritäten: Kampagnen, Flows, Tests und neue Ideen gleichzeitig bringen dich nicht aus dem Takt. Du entscheidest eigenständig, wo der größte Hebel liegt.
  • Du willst gestalten statt verwalten: Du hast den Anspruch, CRM aktiv aufzubauen, Strukturen zu schaffen und bestehende Ansätze kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän: Du arbeitest eng mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen und kannst dich auf Deutsch sehr sicher und klar verständigen.

Bewirb dich nicht, wenn …

  • du ein fertiges CRM-Setup mit bestehenden Prozessen und Playbooks übernehmen möchtest – bei uns baust du vieles selbst auf.
  • du lange Freigabeprozesse einer schnellen, direkten Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung vorziehst.
  • du ausschließlich Kampagnen versenden möchtest, ohne Verantwortung für Segmentierung, Testing und Reporting zu übernehmen.
  • Datenarbeit für dich eher Pflicht als Werkzeug ist und du ausschließlich kreativ arbeiten möchtest.
  • fehlende Prozesse und Unklarheit dich eher stressen als motivieren – ein fertiges CRM-Handbuch gibt es bei uns noch nicht.


Worauf du dich freuen kannst

  • CRM aufbauen statt nur verwalten: Du bekommst volle Gestaltungsfreiheit beim Aufbau unserer CRM-Funktion und kannst Strukturen, Prozesse und Maßnahmen von Grund auf mitgestalten.
  • Eine Datenbasis mit echtem Potenzial: Dich erwartet eine große und stetig wachsende Kontaktbasis – eine seltene Ausgangslage, um mit CRM schnell sichtbare und messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
  • Gemeinsam möchten wir wachsen: Wir setzen auf ein starkes WIR-Gefühl, eine freundschaftliche Teamkultur, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Raum für deine Ideen: Deine Ideen werden gehört und gebraucht – du kannst dich einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und wirklich mitgestalten.
  • Work-Life-Balance ist uns wichtig: du hast flexible Arbeitszeiten, 2 Tage Home-Office pro Woche, 28 Tage Urlaub sowie 5 Tage Workation im Jahr, außerdem hast du an deinem Geburtstag frei!
  • Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft liegen uns am Herzen: Du erhältst Zuschüsse zu Wellpass und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge sowie exklusive Rabatte auf unsere Produkte.
  • Ein Arbeitsplatz zum Wohlfühlen: Dich erwarten moderne, lichtdurchflutete Büros und eine phänomenale Dachterrasse, die zum Durchatmen und Austauschen einlädt.


Du willst Teil der Energiewende werden?

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der erneuerbaren Energien.  Join uns und werde Teil des Teams!

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Start-up im Bereich erneuerbare Energien mit einer klaren Mission: erneuerbare Energie von morgen für alle zugänglich machen. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen einbringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen: in einer dynamischen Umgebung, in der du viel Gestaltungsspielraum hast, Strukturen mit aufbauen kannst, eigene Entscheidungen triffst und direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens nimmst. 

Dabei ist uns egal, woher du kommst, an was du glaubst, wen du liebst, womit du dich identifizierst, wie alt du bist, ob du neurodivers bist oder eine Behinderung hast – die Welt ist bunt und wir können es kaum erwarten, von dir zu lesen! Alle Geschlechter sind Willkommen!

Als Senior HR People & Talent Partner (m/w/d) übernimmst du die operative Personalarbeit für unseren Lagerstandort in Lensahn. Du gewinnst neue Talente, begleitest Mitarbeitende über den gesamten Beschäftigungszeitraum und unterstützt Führungskräfte bei anspruchsvollen Personalentscheidungen. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du HR-Prozesse und setzt Projekte eigenständig um.
Dein Arbeitsplatz ist in unserem Hamburger Office. Zweimal im Monat bist du vor Ort in Lensahn. Du bist Teil unseres HR-Teams und arbeitest eng mit unserer Head of HR, dem COO und unserem Head of Logistics zusammen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Recruiting ganzheitlich verantworten: Du steuerst die Personalgewinnung für Lensahn – von der vorausschauenden Bedarfsplanung über Stellenausschreibungen, aktive Kandidatenansprache und Interviews bis zur Einstellung.
  • Neue Recruiting-Wege erschließen: Du findest geeignete Kanäle für die Gewinnung gewerblicher Mitarbeitender, setzt neue Maßnahmen um und entwickelst eine verlässliche Bewerberpipeline. Dabei behältst du Bewerberqualität und Besetzungsgeschwindigkeit im Blick.

title: (Senior) Marketing Controller (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du reportest nicht, was passiert ist. Du sorgst dafür, dass wir wissen, was als Nächstes passieren muss.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen und gehört zu den am schnellsten wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen Europas.

Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende an unseren Standorten in Hamburg, Kiel und unserem eigenen 22.000 m² Logistikzentrum in Lensahn daran, aus Pammys eine globale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Mit einem Umsatz im mittleren 8-stelligen Bereich, mehreren Millionen Euro Marketinginvestitionen pro Monat, internationalem Wachstum und einem Produktvolumen in Millionenhöhe wird eine Sache immer wichtiger:

Finanzielle Steuerung auf höchstem Niveau.

Deshalb bauen wir unser Controlling massiv aus und suchen vier (Senior) Controller / Finance Business Partner (m/w/d), die gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase steuern.

Bei uns geht es nicht darum, Excel-Dateien zu verwalten oder rückblickend Zahlen zusammenzufassen.

Du sitzt nah an den Entscheidungen, challengest Annahmen, erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und übersetzt Zahlen in konkrete Maßnahmen.

Dein Ziel: Wachstum profitabel machen und jederzeit wissen, welche Stellschraube den größten finanziellen Impact hat.

Je nach Erfahrung und Schwerpunkt übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen oder mehrere unserer zentralen Unternehmensbereiche wie Marketing & E-Commerce, Product & Sourcing, Operations & Logistics oder Corporate Finance.


Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst im Marketing die Analyse und Weiterentwicklung unserer Kennzahlen und schaffst damit eine fundierte Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen.

  • Du analysierst relevante Marketing-KPIs und stellst sicher, dass Abweichungen frühzeitig erkannt und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abgeleitet werden.
  • Du bewertest die Performance unserer Marketingkanäle und Kampagnen bis auf Zielgruppen-, Produkt- oder Marktebene und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale.
  • Du analysierst Conversion Rates, Kundenakquisitionskosten, Return on Ad Spend und Customer Lifetime Value und machst Zusammenhänge transparent.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Marketing, Finance und Data aussagekräftige Reportings, Dashboards und Frühwarnsysteme.
  • Du verbindest Marketing-Kennzahlen mit wirtschaftlichen Ergebnissen und zeigst auf, welche Maßnahmen zur Kundengewinnung, Kundenbindung und Profitabilität beitragen.
  • Du erstellst Performance-Prognosen und Szenarioanalysen und bewertest die möglichen Auswirkungen unterschiedlicher Marketingmaßnahmen.
  • Du definierst gemeinsam mit den Verantwortlichen klare Zielwerte, Benchmarks und Performance-KPIs und machst die Zielerreichung messbar.
  • Du analysierst die Customer Journey und den Conversion Funnel und identifizierst Potenziale zur Verbesserung von Conversion, Wiederkaufrate und Kundenwert.
  • Du wertest A/B-Tests und Kampagnenexperimente aus und leitest fundierte Empfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Marketingaktivitäten ab.
  • Du stellst die Qualität, Konsistenz und Nachvollziehbarkeit unserer Marketingdaten sicher und entwickelst Kennzahlendefinitionen sowie Messmethoden weiter.
  • Du treibst die Automatisierung und Standardisierung des Marketing-Reportings voran.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Geschäftsführung, Finance, Data und Sales zusammen und bereitest Erkenntnisse verständlich und entscheidungsorientiert auf.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Finance, Controlling, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Besonders spannend ist Erfahrung aus E-Commerce, D2C, Retail, Fashion, FMCG oder einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.
  • Du verstehst Marketing nicht nur technisch, sondern kannst erklären, welche operative Entscheidung hinter einer Veränderung steckt.
  • Du bist extrem sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets und kannst auch große Datenmengen strukturiert analysieren.
  • Erfahrung mit BI-Tools, ERP-Systemen und automatisierten Reportings ist ein großes Plus.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch und präzise, verlierst dich aber nicht in Analysen, sondern kommst schnell zu einer klaren Empfehlung.
  • Du hast den Anspruch, Zahlen zu challengen, statt sie lediglich entgegenzunehmen.
  • Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte so erklären, dass auch Nicht-Marketer verstehen, was zu tun ist.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem Entscheidungen schnell getroffen und Ergebnisse klar gemessen werden.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Echter Einfluss: Deine Analysen landen nicht in einer Präsentation, sondern direkt in operativen und strategischen Entscheidungen.
  • Unternehmerisches Controlling: Du bekommst eigene Verantwortungsbereiche und wirst zum Sparringspartner für die jeweiligen Führungskräfte.
  • Außergewöhnliche Skalierung: Du begleitest ein Unternehmen auf dem Weg vom mittleren 8-stelligen in den mittleren 9-stelligen Umsatzbereich.
  • Komplexität, an der du wachsen kannst: E-Commerce, Marketing, internationale Märkte, eigene Logistik, Sourcing und Millionen von Produkten ergeben ein Finance-Umfeld, das weit über klassisches Controlling hinausgeht.
  • Gestaltung statt Verwaltung: Viele Strukturen entstehen gerade erst. Du kannst Prozesse, Dashboards, KPIs und Steuerungsmodelle aktiv mit aufbauen.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Gute Analysen werden schnell in Entscheidungen übersetzt.
  • High-Performance-Umfeld: Klare Ziele, messbare Ergebnisse, hohe Eigenverantwortung und der Anspruch, jeden Bereich kontinuierlich besser zu machen.
  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit dem weiteren Wachstum entstehen zusätzliche Verantwortungsbereiche und Führungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb unseres Finance-Teams.
  • Zusätzliche Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatte, Corporate Benefits, kostenlose Getränke und weitere Vorteile.

title: People Operations Manager
description:
Why Rogo

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

This is a unique opportunity to join a generational company driving transformation in one of the most important industries in the world. With a rapidly growing, global client base, proven product-market fit, and backing from world-class investors, we are scaling quickly and defining a new category of enterprise AI.

Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us.

The Role

We’re hiring our first UK-based People Operations Manager to build and scale our People function across the UK and EMEA. Reporting to our People Lead, you’ll be a trusted partner to leaders and employees, shaping the employee experience as we grow.

You’ll have the autonomy to set priorities, build solutions, and drive them from idea to execution. We’re looking for someone who pairs strong judgment with hands-on execution and brings clarity and structure to a fast-moving business.

What You’ll Own

People Programs & Systems

  • EMEA Expansion: Shape our People approach as we enter new markets, anticipating hiring and operational needs and building infrastructure that scales.

  • Onboarding: Build a thoughtful, efficient onboarding experience that sets new hires up for success.

  • Performance & Engagement: Run performance review and engagement survey cycles, equipping managers with clear guidance and turning feedback into action.

  • Tools & Data: Own People systems, workflows, and data accuracy across the employee lifecycle. Improve automations and integrations to keep operations running smoothly.

Benefits, Immigration & Compliance

  • Benefits: Manage and evolve our benefits programs, partnering with providers to deliver a seamless employee experience.

  • Immigration & Mobility: Own visa sponsorship, renewals, and international relocations, coordinating with Recruiting, Legal, and external counsel to keep processes moving and employees informed.

  • HR Compliance: Maintain employment policies, documentation, and compliance processes, working with Legal and external advisors to navigate requirements across markets.

Culture & Manager Partnership

  • Manager Support: Be a trusted partner on team growth, performance, feedback, and day-to-day people decisions. Build practical resources that strengthen management practices.

  • Culture & Connection: Create meaningful opportunities for connection and recognition as the team grows.

  • Communication: Keep employee resources clear and current, and make People programs easy to understand and navigate.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with the People Lead to set priorities and adapt company-wide programs to local needs.

  • Work with Finance, Legal, Recruiting, and Leadership to drive expansion and operational improvements.

  • Spot gaps, recommend solutions, and lead projects through implementation.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of People Operations or HR experience in a high-growth environment.

  • Experience supporting rapid expansion across EMEA, including scaling operations across countries and navigating local employment practices.

  • Hands-on experience with UK immigration and visa sponsorship, plus exposure to immigration and employee mobility across EMEA.

  • A track record of building effective programs and processes with minimal direction.

  • Strong judgment—you connect employee needs with business priorities and know when to act independently or bring in a partner.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to drive initiatives across teams from start to finish.

  • Experience owning HR systems, workflows, and automations; Rippling experience highly preferred.

  • Clear communication, high emotional intelligence, and discretion with sensitive information.

  • A bias toward action—you find answers, sweat the details, and follow through.

Who You Are

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments. You are high-intensity and care a lot about what you do, and you're ecstatic to work at a startup.

  • You are ambitious. You have fun solving problems that others think are impossible.

  • You are curious. You find joy in learning about AI, technology, and finance.

  • You are an owner. You are autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

  • You are collaborative, organized, thoughtful, and kind.

  • Lead the launch and scale of new high-potential channels while ensuring Meta, Google and TikTok maintain a best-in-class foundation from day one

  • Establish what works in two distinct markets and build the repeatable playbook to scale it

  • Systematically analyse creative output to build and refine our hook and concept library, providing actionable feedback to the in-house creators

  • Adapt messaging and creative to the cultural and linguistic nuances of the US and Mexican audiences

Optimisation & Measurement:

  • Execute daily and weekly optimisations across paid channels, leveraging internal attribution models to inform bidding and budget allocation decisions

description:
Note: Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.


🚀 Our Story

Partly's mission is to connect the world's parts and we're doing that by building the first global platform for replacement parts, starting with auto parts. Our big vision is to accelerate the world towards a sustainable future where waste is eliminated and all replacement parts are universally searchable, accessible and available to all.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we utilise bleeding-edge technology to solve challenging but exciting problems that make a huge impact in a $1.9 trillion industry. We've more than tripled our team over the last 12 months and expect to double in size again over the coming 12 months. We're a global team spanning both Europe and Australasia.

We provide a scalable digital infrastructure solution to some of the world's largest businesses and the most exciting startups. Partly's solutions are integrated across hundreds of companies globally, providing the backbone for cataloguing and managing parts online.

Our investors in Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), Square Peg, Octopus Ventures, Icehouse, Peter Beck (Rocket Lab), Akshay Kothari (Notion Co-Founder) and Dylan Field (Figma Co-Founder).

We're continuing to build a world-class team and ensuring Partly is a place where people can do the best work of their lives. We're proud of the culture we've built at Partly, and our values are lived throughout every experience.

🖍️ This role

You own Partly's multi-site repairer groups and you carry a revenue goal on them. Not the signature, the revenue: getting sites live, getting them buying through us, and putting Repair AI into the way they work.

This is the first hire of its kind at Partly. You are the first Enterprise Account Manager, so there is no playbook and no ramp to inherit. You will work out what makes a group go from signed to ordering most of its parts through us, prove it on your own accounts, and write the motion the next people run. Do this well and this becomes a team, and you have a claim on leading it.

 

💻 What will you do

Get signed sites live

  • Own the go-live of every site in your book, from signature to first order, and carry the number for how many are live rather than how many are signed

  • Run the rollout with each group's head office: site lists, sequencing, who trains, what the first week looks like

Own the rollout of Repair AI

  • Own the rollout of our flagship agentic capability, across your groups. You are the person who takes it from a handful of sites to the way these businesses work.

  • Run the pilots and prove the case with the customer's own data: hours out of the parts process, margin won, jobs touched. Then get it out of the pilot site and across the group

  • Find the next job worth giving to an agent. You will sit closer to how a bodyshop actually runs than anyone else at Partly, and most of that day is still manual. Come back with where the next one is and the evidence for it

  • Feed what breaks straight to product, in detail, so Repair AI is built against real shops rather than assumptions

Own the commercials on your accounts

  • Carry the commercial relationship: rates, rollout commitments, renewals and the terms that come with them

  • Structure deals so both sides win when adoption rises, and hold groups to what they committed to

  • Escalate to the Sales Director when a group's economics do not fit the standard shape, with a proposal rather than a problem

Build the playbook

  • Work out what makes a group go from signed to ordering, and what makes one stall. The pattern is not written down anywhere today

  • Prove it on your own book first, then turn it into something repeatable: the rollout sequence, the pilot, the proof, the conversation that changes how a site buys

  • Make it survive you. The measure is whether the next person can pick it up and get the same result, not whether you personally carried the number

  • Write it so the next hire can pick it up and get the same result. If you do, this seat becomes a team and you have a claim on leading it

 

🥷 Your skills

 

  • You've taken an early product into an existing customer base, where the pitch is not finished and the first pilots decide whether it lands

  • Can design the playbook, not just run one. There is no template for this seat and no ramp to inherit. You will work out what actually moves a signed group from live to ordering, prove it on your own accounts, and write it down so the next person can run it

  • You have carried and hit a number on existing accounts, through adoption and expansion rather than new logos alone

  • Commercially credible and self sufficient with account data. You can diagnose an account and build your own views rather than waiting for someone to build them

  • Comfortable where the playbook is still being written, and happy to write it

  • Willing to get into the market. Our customers are bodyshops and the job does not work from a desk

  • (Bonus) Automotive aftermarket, collision repair or parts distribution background, or having sold a product where usage rather than signature is the paid event

Please note: if you don't have all the skills or experience listed above but believe you could be outstanding in this role, please still consider applying. Many people count themselves out. We'd love the chance to learn more about you and why you're exceptional.

 

🎁 Benefits

  • Healthy, Catered Lunches - Enjoy fresh, healthy lunches every workday in our Auckland, Christchurch, London, and Austin offices. With no meal prep needed, you can eat, connect, and refuel with your team. (And yes, snacks and drinks are always on hand.)

  • Healthy Body, Healthy Mind - We care about performing at our peak. Every team member gets a $1,500 annual wellness allowance (or local equivalent) on a Partly-branded card. Use it on things such as gym memberships, rock climbing, physical therapy, massage, doctor visits, prescriptions—anything that you or your family need!

  • Family Comes First - Primary caregivers receive 3 months of fully paid parental leave, plus a flexible return-to-work plan (four days a week at full pay for your first three months back).

  • Workspaces That Inspire - Our brand-new, architecturally designed offices are built for collaboration and creativity, with great coffee, social spaces, and some of the best cafes just a few steps away.

  • Getting Here Is On Us - If you commute to a Partly office or coworking space (atleast 4 days a week), choose from a paid 24/7 parking spot or a commuting allowance. One less thing to think about!

  • Office-First with Flexibility - In cities where we have an office (Christchurch, Auckland, London, and Austin), we default to working from the office every day. This lets us move faster, make better decisions, and build strong relationships. We also operate with a high-trust environment, so you can manage your time around your life and flex your schedule to do your best work.

  • Time Off - you can use your annual leave and sick leave from day one, no waiting to accrue it first. And if you ever go into a negative balance, that's fine too, we trust you to manage your own time off

  • We Celebrate Together - From weekly happy hours and monthly lunches to quarterly season openers and an annual global offsite, we make time to connect, celebrate, and have fun as one team.

  • Giving - We support charitable giving and will top up your donation by 33% for charities on the GiveWell list

  • Equity - You'll receive share options (ESOP) with a 4-year vesting schedule and a 1-year cliff, true ownership in Partly from day one. Your strike price is a flat $0.01 per share, and you have up to 10 years to exercise.

     

🛬 Relocation

If you're relocating to Partly HQ, whether from overseas or within the country, we offer a generous relocation allowance to help support your move.
