title: Software Architect - Tracking
description:
This is the senior computer vision engineering authority for Hawk-Eye's tracking technology, and it is an individual contributor role.

Our tracking sits underneath almost everything Hawk-Eye sells. Goal-line technology, semi-automated offside, electronic line calling, automated ball-strike. Live and post-game data. It runs across football, baseball, tennis, American football, ice hockey, cricket, basketball and rugby, on-premise, in the cloud and increasingly on edge devices, delivered by over 100 engineers in the Tracking and Automated Officiating value stream.

You would be the person who decides how that is built. The role carries two hats. As Software Architect you own the software-level architectural design across tracking, auto-officiating and data delivery. As computer vision authority you lead the core domains: camera calibration, ball tracking, skeletal tracking, and the R&D that feeds them.

It is a hands-on job. You set architecture for new tracking problems as they arrive, you safeguard the shared frameworks, and when a live delivery is at risk you are the escalation point who gets into the code.

What you would own

Architecture across the value stream. You are the lead architect for every tracking and auto-officiating product in T&AO. You set the initial architecture when a new tracking problem enters the business, run the Software Domain Owner model so shared libraries like calibration have named codeowners, and keep designs consistent across sports. You represent tracking in the Engineering Architecture Steering group and feed into architecture conversations across Hawk-Eye and the wider Sony Sports organisation.

Part of that is judgement about reuse. Keeping value streams on a common tracking codebase pays off until it doesn't, and knowing where that line sits is the job.

Computer vision direction. You are the subject matter authority. You decide where our vision processing and ML integration goes next, research new tracking technologies and bring them in, and build prototypes when a proposal needs proving rather than describing.

Modern tooling, properly evaluated. We want agentic coding frameworks, LLM-driven development tools and automated code generation working inside heavy C++ and Python codebases, with guidelines that hold up. You would lead that adoption and decide what earns its place.

Growing other engineers. You coach the Squad Tech Leads, guide junior architects, and run CV Algorithm talks, HawkTalks and tutorials. You also help us hire well, including technical assessment for CV and ML roles.

The awkward bits. Operational health of ML training and synthetic data infrastructure sits with you, including escalating the gaps in ownership and support with options attached.

What we are looking for

The core of it is deep multi-camera computer vision. Camera calibration including intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion models, anti-wobble and bundle adjustment. Triangulation. 3D ball and pose estimation, skeletal tracking, continuous-time modelling, inverse kinematics.

On top of that:

  • Expert cross-platform C++ across Windows and Linux, x86 and ARM, with CMake and real performance profiling ability

  • Strong working knowledge of GPU inference (TensorRT, Triton) and ML pipelines (PyTorch, ONNX)

  • Proven experience running tracking at scale in AWS, on-premise and on edge devices

  • Hands-on use of AI coding agents and LLM orchestration to accelerate algorithm R&D and refactoring in large codebases

  • A working understanding of generative AI, synthetic data generation and where they genuinely help real-time CV

The parts that are harder to put in a bullet point. You can set architecture across many squads and sports and make pragmatic calls on reuse, cost and time to market. You write clearly: design documents, proposals with options, explanations a non-technical stakeholder can follow. You are comfortable in front of external engineering partners, which here means Sony, NVIDIA and AWS alongside sports leagues and federations. And you can size work honestly, state your confidence in it, and say what we should stop or delay.

What this role is not

Worth being direct about, because senior CV engineers are usually offered the other thing.

This is not a people management role. Nobody reports to you. Line management sits elsewhere and we are not planning to move it.

It is not project or delivery management either. Delivery Leads coordinate squad delivery across T&AO. You own technical direction and escalation, not sprint management.

You are not a Product Owner. Product sets the market and problem priorities, you work with them to define the solution.

You are not a Squad Tech Lead. Day-to-day technical leadership of squads sits with the Squad Tech Leads and Engineering Leads. You mentor them and step in on the complex and high-risk problems.

And you are not a gatekeeper for other value streams. You give them alignment and access to shared tracking IP. You do not own their roadmaps.

title: Technical Claims Manager
description:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

The team

Zego’s Claims department is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a highly skilled Technical Claims Manager to elevate our standards of technical excellence. In this pivotal role, as a Technical Claims Manager, you’ll drive excellence, quality, and innovation. You will lead the performance of our Quality Assurance Framework, ensuring best-in-class auditing of both our internal claims team and external providers. Your expertise will ensure that every aspect of our claims handling, from technical precision to customer experience, meets and exceeds industry-leading standards.

We’re looking for an analytical and detail-oriented claims expert with a strong technical background in motor claims. You must have hands-on experience in handling and/or auditing motor claims. If you're ready to make an impact, drive innovation, and set new standards in claims excellence, we’d love to hear from you! 🚀

What you will be doing

  • Lead continuous improvements of our Quality Assurance Framework, ensuring technical excellence across all claims processes.

  • Deal with complex indemnity referrals applying all relevant legislation and delivering swift resolutions for our customers.

  • Develop and refine best-practice documentation, keeping our teams equipped with cutting-edge claims strategies.

  • Train, mentor, and develop our claims team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.

  • Monitor, analyse, and report on claims initiatives, identifying opportunities to optimise efficiency and drive performance improvements.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with experts across Fraud, Data, Product Management, Engineering, Actuarial, Reserving, and Sales to enhance our claims strategy.

  • Represent Zego in supplier and client meetings, building strong external relationships and ensuring alignment with our quality and service expectations.

  • Shape the future of claims processing, influencing system development, enhancing automation capabilities, and driving innovation.

  • Champion claims data quality and completeness, working closely with our Data and Product teams to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and actionable across all internal systems.

What you will need to be successful

  • Proven track record of hands-on motor claims experience within an insurance company, ideally within an Insurtech or Motor Insurance provider where innovation meets efficiency.

  • Excellent technical claims knowledge from handling and/or auditing a wide variety of claims across AD, TPVD & TPPI, ideally including Large Loss

  • Experience of dealing with indemnity referrals and confidence making nuanced decisions around issues such as misrepresentation

  • A natural leader, confident in your ideas but adaptable to change, thriving in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  • CII Certificate is a plus, but your expertise and impact matter most.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

Job title: Head of Accounting

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Direct Reports: 2 Accounting Team Members

Scope: Global Accounting Oversight for PUR Group Entities

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Local, Permanent, Full time

About PUR

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

Position Summary

The Heah of Accounting is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of PUR's accounting records and financial reporting across the Group. The role oversees day-to-day accounting operations, coordinates monthly and annual closings, manages statutory and tax compliance, and serves as the primary accounting counterpart for Regional Accounting and Finance Managers in Latin America, Africa, and Asia.

You will lead a team of two accounting professionals and contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes, internal controls, and reporting systems to support PUR's growth and international operations.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Operations & Financial Close

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes for Group entities.

  • Ensure timely and accurate recording of accounting transactions in accordance with local GAAP and Group accounting policies.

  • Review and validate general ledger entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

  • Monitor accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, and intercompany transactions.

  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of accounting practices across entities.

Group Coordination

  • Act as the primary accounting liaison with Regional Accounting and Finance Managers in: Latin America, Africa and Asia

  • Coordinate closing calendars, reporting packages, and accounting guidelines.

  • Support regional teams in resolving complex accounting matters and ensuring compliance with Group policies.

  • Review key accounting judgments and significant transactions across regions.

Statutory Accounts & Compliance

  • Coordinate preparation of annual statutory financial statements.

  • Ensure compliance with local accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements.

  • Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, accountants, and regulatory authorities.

  • Support the preparation of audit files and responses to audit requests.

  • Monitor evolving accounting and regulatory requirements and ensure appropriate implementation.

Consolidation & Group Reporting

  • Support the preparation of consolidated financial information for management and shareholders.

  • Ensure timely submission of reporting packages from regional entities.

  • Review intercompany balances and transactions and coordinate reconciliation processes.

  • Assist in the implementation and maintenance of Group reporting standards.

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

  • Maintain robust accounting controls and documentation.

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting activities.

  • Strengthen financial controls, accounting procedures, and reporting accuracy.

  • Contribute to ERP and finance system optimization initiatives.

Treasury & Cash Management Support

  • Monitor cash accounting and treasury-related transactions.

  • Ensure proper accounting treatment of financing arrangements, loans, and intercompany funding.

  • Support working capital management through accurate balance sheet monitoring.

Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop two accounting team members.

  • Allocate responsibilities and monitor workload to ensure efficiency and quality.

description:
OVERVIEW

Formance builds programmable financial infrastructure. Our open-source ledger helps engineering teams model, track, and reconcile money movements across financial products, from payment platforms to fintech applications and digital-asset businesses.

Financial infrastructure requires precision. Teams need to understand where money is, how it moves, and whether their systems reflect what actually happened. We build the tools to help them answer those questions.

YOUR ROLE

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer with a strong technical foundation and experience in fintech or payments to join our team.

You’ll work with prospective customers to understand their architecture, map their financial flows, and demonstrate how Formance fits their requirements. You’ll partner closely with our sales, product, and engineering teams throughout the evaluation process.

This role combines technical depth with commercial judgment. You should be comfortable building a proof of concept, discussing architectural tradeoffs with an engineer, and explaining the business implications to a founder.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead technical discovery with engineering and product teams to understand their financial workflows, constraints, and evaluation criteria.

  • Build tailored demos and proofs of concept using Formance’s APIs and tooling.

  • Guide technical evaluations, investigate questions, and help prospects assess product fit.

  • Partner with sales to connect technical capabilities to business needs and move opportunities forward.

  • Bring customer feedback to product and engineering, with concrete examples of gaps and recurring needs.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking infrastructure, or digital-asset infrastructure. You understand how money moves through a financial product and the operational challenges involved.

  • A strong technical foundation. You can work with APIs, read and write code, debug integrations, and reason about data models and system architecture.

  • Experience working directly with customers, through solutions engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, or an engineering role with significant customer exposure.

  • The ability to ask precise questions, uncover requirements, and explain complex concepts clearly.

  • Commercial judgment: you understand how a technical evaluation contributes to a buying decision.

  • A hands-on approach and the ability to work independently in a small team.

  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to lead technical conversations with international customers.

Useful additional experience

  • Working with ledgers, double-entry accounting, reconciliation, or payment orchestration.

  • Supporting technical evaluations for API-first or developer-facing products.

  • Building financial workflows involving multiple currencies, payment providers, or digital assets.

  • Turning recurring customer questions into reusable demos, documentation, or tools.

WHY JOIN FORMANCE?

You’ll work directly with teams building financial products and help them make consequential infrastructure decisions.

You’ll have ownership of technical evaluations, close access to product and engineering, and the opportunity to shape how we demonstrate and explain Formance. Your work will influence both customer decisions and the product we build.

BENEFITS

  • Flexible remote work policy

  • Health insurance: Alan Blue, with your partner and dependent children covered at no cost from day one.

  • Meal vouchers: €10 per day worked, with 55% covered by Formance.

  • Equipment: A MacBook from day one, plus a €500 onboarding budget for your workspace equipment.

  • Parenthood support: Formance maintains 100% of your salary during the first month of additional birth leave.

  • Company offsite: An annual company offsite, fully organized and covered by Formance.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

About the role

You’ll join an AI-native engineering team where AI is central to how we design, build and ship software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands software deeply, uses AI to build better software faster, and wants to help improve how the whole team works.

You will own projects from understanding the customer problem to shipping a solution and improving it in production. Working closely with engineering and product, you will help decide what we build, how we build it, and where to invest as the platform grows.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. Your focus will reflect your strengths and the team’s priorities, whether that means building product experiences, developing backend services, or solving challenges across the platform. We value engineers who bring depth in their area and curiosity beyond it.

What you’ll do

  • Own projects from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment and follow-up.

  • Work closely with product and other engineers to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions and turn complex requirements into clear, usable software.

  • Build and improve the interfaces, APIs and services that financial institutions rely on for their compliance operations.

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing delivery speed with reliability, security and maintainability.

  • Investigate production issues and improve performance, observability and resilience as the platform grows.

  • Raise the engineering bar through knowledge sharing and improvements to how we develop and ship software.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our platform as we build more AI-powered compliance capabilities.

About you

  • You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and maintaining software in production.

  • You understand software in depth. You bring strong fundamentals and depth in backend or full-stack development. You can reason about data, concurrency, performance and failure modes, and investigate unfamiliar systems beyond the surface.

  • AI coding agents are central to how you work. You use tools such as Codex or Claude Code extensively to explore, build, test and review software. You keep experimenting with ways to make yourself more effective.

  • You bring the judgment that makes AI-assisted development work. You frame problems clearly, provide useful context, challenge assumptions and verify the resulting behavior. You can explain why a solution works and take responsibility for what you ship.

  • You take ownership. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a practical plan, follow through on delivery and improve the result in production. You are comfortable learning new technologies and working beyond your usual area when a problem calls for it.

  • You care about the product as much as the implementation. You want to understand who you are building for, challenge requirements when needed and assess whether your work solves the original problem.

  • You value simple, well-designed solutions. You know when to move quickly and when reliability, security or long-term maintenance require more care.

  • You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating. You explain your technical choices, welcome constructive disagreement and share what you learn with your teammates.

  • You want to help shape an AI-native engineering team. You enjoy improving how software gets built, from reusable agent workflows to better testing and feedback loops, and turning your own discoveries into practices that make the whole team more effective.

Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech or compliance is a plus.

Our technology

Our main language is TypeScript. Our stack includes:

  • Frontend: React, Apollo GraphQL and Storybook.

  • Backend: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Infrastructure: AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Development and testing: Nx, GitLab CI, Playwright.

You do not need experience with every part of our stack. We care about your engineering judgment, your ability to learn and the quality of the software you build.

Why join us

  • Join a company with traction and room to shape its future. With 100+ financial institutions using Dotfile and a recent Series A, you’ll help define the next stage of the product and engineering team.

  • Help shape how an AI-native team works. Experiment with new approaches, improve your own workflow and turn what you learn into practices that make the whole team more effective.

  • Put your engineering depth to work. Solve demanding problems in automation, AI, data and reliability, building software that financial institutions depend on every day.

  • Have a direct say in what you build. Influence technical decisions, own projects through to production, and see how your work changes the customer experience.


Our hiring process

  1. CTO conversation — 30-60 minutes : Discuss your background, explore the role and how our engineering team works, and answer technical questions to assess your engineering knowledge and problem-solving approach.

  2. Case study — 60 minutes : Design the architecture of a project we provide, or present the architecture of a past project you led. Walk us through your reasoning, technical decisions and trade-offs.

  3. Raise the bar — 30 minutes: Meet someone from Product or Solutions Consulting to discuss how you collaborate across teams, understand customer needs and approach problems together.

  4. Founder discussion — 15-30 minutes: Meet our CEO to discuss Dotfile’s ambition, what motivates you and the contribution you could make.

title: Product Director
description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

 

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

 

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

 

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

 

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Product Director to help define and build the next generation of Dotfile.

You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design and our customers to turn complex compliance problems into simple, powerful product experiences. You will own major areas of the product end-to-end: understanding the problem, designing the system, prototyping solutions, shipping with Engineering, and learning from how customers use them.

This is a builder role. You will be expected to go deep into workflows, data models and technical constraints, work directly with engineers and designers, and prototype ideas yourself when that is the fastest way to move forward. You should care as much about how the underlying system works as you do about the user experience built on top of it.

AI is at the core of Dotfile’s product. You will design systems where agents investigate, reason and act across complex compliance workflows, and use AI extensively in your own work to research, prototype and ship faster.

You will lead a small Product team while remaining deeply involved in the work yourself. You will coach and develop the people on your team, raise the bar for product thinking and execution, and create the environment for them to do their best work. This is not a role where management means stepping away from the product.

You will work directly with the CEO and CTO.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Own major product areas end-to-end, from understanding the problem and defining the underlying system to shipping, adoption and iteration

  • Lead and develop a small Product team, setting a high bar for product thinking, execution and ownership while remaining deeply hands-on yourself

  • Turn complex compliance workflows into simple, programmable product experiences that can scale across customers, use cases and jurisdictions

  • Work closely with Engineering and Design on product architecture, data models, workflows and technical trade-offs

  • Design how AI agents interact with data, users and other systems to investigate cases, make recommendations and increasingly automate compliance work

  • Prototype ideas quickly using AI and modern development tools to explore interactions, validate concepts and communicate what should be built

  • Spend significant time with customers and internal teams to understand how compliance actually gets done, identify recurring problems and turn them into scalable product capabilities

  • Define clear measures of product success, use data and customer behavior to evaluate what we ship, and iterate quickly when something is not working

  • Continuously improve how we build product at Dotfile, using AI to accelerate research, analysis, prototyping, specification and execution

 

About you

  • You have 6+ years of experience building software products, including significant ownership of complex B2B or infrastructure products

  • You have experience managing and developing product people, while remaining close to the product and comfortable owning problems directly yourself

  • You are deeply technical for a product leader. You are comfortable discussing APIs, data models, system architecture, integrations and technical trade-offs directly with engineers

  • You think in systems. You naturally look beyond individual features to understand the underlying primitives, abstractions and interactions that make a product scalable

  • You are extremely hands-on. You like getting into the details, exploring data, prototyping ideas and working directly with engineers and designers

  • AI is already deeply embedded in how you work. You use LLMs, coding tools and agents to research, analyze, prototype and build, and actively experiment with new capabilities as they emerge

  • You have strong product judgment and can turn ambiguous, complex problems into products that feel simple to users

  • You are comfortable building AI products where outputs are probabilistic and care deeply about evaluation, reliability, observability, human oversight and feedback loops

  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment with high standards and strong ownership, and know how to create that environment for the people you manage

 

The interview process

Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

Round 2: Two-part discussion where you’ll walk us through your career journey and the choices that shaped it, followed by a values-based interview.

Round 3: Deep dive into one of your key projects with someone from a different team, offering a fresh, cross-functional perspective on how you work.

Round 4: Practical exercise, case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

Round 5: Final conversation with our founder.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.

As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.

  • Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and communicating the business impact of AI adoption in clear, compelling terms.

title: STAGE - Junior Fullstack Engineer - Jobexit
description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre
  • Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple)
  • Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques
  • Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat
  • Et d'autres fonctionnalités !

Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Jobexit et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).

 


Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Payroll Specialist
description:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

 

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team:

You're joining as we reshape the People & Operations Experience team, which brings together ops, payroll, people tech, engagement and internal comms. That makes this a build-and-run role. You'll run payroll from day one and help design how the function works going forward, from processes to tooling to documentation.

 
 

The role

You'll take ownership of French payroll, starting with a proper handover from the colleague who runs it today and building towards running it independently. Alongside it, you'll look after the employee lifecycle: joiners, leavers and everything in between. It's real responsibility, with a team around you.

Your development goes in two directions: continuous improvement of how People Ops works, and a progressive move into Global Payroll (US, UK, Singapore) as your confidence and scope grow. Your arrival also creates room for the whole team to take on bigger things, and that includes you.

 

What you'll do

 

Own French payroll

  • Run the full monthly cycle: data collection, absences and leave, inputs, controls, validation and payslip checks

  • Prepare and submit statutory filings on time (URSSAF, DSN, IJSS/Net-entreprise and other mandatory declarations)

  • Manage variable pay and contractual changes, and build the VPI file for ADP Decidium

  • Work with Finance on transfer files, cost reporting, headcount tracking and variance analysis

  • Handle day to day equity payroll declarations (stock options / BSPCE) as you slowly build your expertise

  • Manage benefits, meal vouchers and provider relationships

  • Track regulatory changes and turn them into better processes

 

Run the employee lifecycle

  • Handle joiners and leavers: contracts, health insurance and transport registration, visa and absence data

  • Keep Workday data accurate and compliant

  • Help document and improve the processes being rebuilt, and contribute to cross-functional People projects

  • You'll work with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, C&B and our provider ADP.

 

What you bring

  • 2–3 years of French payroll experience, with hands-on exposure to the monthly cycle and a readiness to own it

  • Solid knowledge of French social legislation (URSSAF, DSN) and experience with a payroll tool (ADP or similar)

  • Rigour: you close the month on time, without being chased

  • A builder's instinct: you document as you go and like making things work better

  • Comfort working in English in a multicultural team

  • Curiosity about international payroll and a real appetite to widen your scope

 

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

 

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

 

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

title: Technical Lead - AI Ops
description:

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. title: Senior Demande Generation Manager
description:
About Scality

Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.
 
Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. 
 
The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F
 
ollow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

About the role
Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific.
 
This is a hands-on role for a marketer who thinks strategically. You take a pipeline target, decide how to reach it, and run the campaigns that get there. You hold yourself to the numbers: leads and opportunities generated, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and channel efficiency. Most of the work is digital. You also run the campaigns around our webinars, trade shows, and partner programs, from promotion to lead follow up.
 
The main challenge is generating demand in a market that is changing fast. Buyers increasingly get their information from AI tools rather than the channels marketers have relied on, and gated content and volume downloads are losing their effect. This role needs the creativity to build demand where the old playbooks no longer work.

You own the campaign function in an international marketing team. You work closely with the Head of Growth, who runs paid media, SEO, and web, and with marketing operations and nurture. You work with the AMER field marketing manager and the EMEA regional marketing team on campaigns for their events and partner programs, and with product marketing on messaging and assets. You also work with sales, SDR, and partner teams in every region.

What you will be doing
  • Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing
  • Take each campaign from brief to launch: audience and targeting, offer, messaging with product marketing, landing pages and forms, promotion, lead routing, and reporting
  • Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after
  • Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up
  • Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels
  • Build campaigns with marketing operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, and own campaign structure, naming, and attribution in Salesforce
  • Own weekly and monthly lead generation reporting to marketing and executive leadership: leads and opportunities against goal, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and spend by channel and region
  • Align with sales and SDR teams across regions on lead handoff, follow up, and pipeline acceleration
  • Manage campaign budgets and agencies, and prioritize spend against pipeline impact
  • Run experiments across audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion and lower acquisition cost

    • What you bring to the table
  • Ten years or more of experience in lead generation, demand generation, or digital marketing, running integrated campaigns end to end
  • International experience: you have run campaigns across several regions, ideally including the US, and understand how buyers and channels differ by market
  • Experience in B2B enterprise software, ideally in storage, data management, backup, or adjacent data infrastructure markets
  • A track record of campaigns that produced measurable pipeline, with the numbers to back it up
  • Hands-on experience with paid social and paid search, and with webinar and event campaigns 
  • Strong command of HubSpot and Salesforce and of campaign analytics
  • The ability to shape a plan from a pipeline target while staying hands on in execution
  • The creativity to generate demand where buyers rely on AI over traditional channels and gated content no longer carries the funnel
  • Native or near-native English, written and spoken. You write campaign copy for US and international audiences
  • Comfort working with colleagues across time zones, with regular overlap with the US team in the afternoon

    • Life at Scality
  • We offer careers with an opportunity to bridge international borders, an intensely fun environment with smart people.
  • We encourage promotion and elevation through training and development programs.
  • We care for our employees through company supported programs such as sports and wellness programs, social responsibility programs, and generous benefits packages.
  • We support team building and get together events across all of our locations around the world.
  • Life at Scality is exhilarating. Our internal motto is: work hard, play hard, eat well and amaze the customer!

Qui sommes-nous ? 

 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France.

  • Être le référent technique pour toutes les questions liées au SCADA et à la gestion des installations éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage en exploitation.

  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives 
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs

De formation ingénieur généraliste, vous disposez de solides compétences techniques et aimez évoluer dans des environnements à la croisée de plusieurs expertises. 

Vous avez notamment de bonnes connaissances en automatisme, ainsi qu’en informatique et réseaux de communication. Des bases en électricité HT/BT vous permettent également de comprendre les principaux enjeux techniques liés aux installations.

Une première expérience dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables serait un véritable atout, mais c’est avant tout votre curiosité, votre autonomie et votre envie de relever des défis techniques qui feront la différence ! 

 

Localisation et déplacements : 

Le poste implique des déplacements réguliers sur les différents sites de l’entreprise à travers la France, représentant environ 25 % du temps de travail. 

Vous êtes donc mobile et appréciez le fait de pouvoir alterner entre travail au bureau et interventions directement sur le terrain.

Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives.

title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.
  • Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage.
  • You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume.
  • Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built.


Why us?

LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification.

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it.

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like.

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market.

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional.

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
description:
Description

Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.


Your mission

Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.


Your profile

The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant: a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer.

3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome.

You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter.

4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus.


Why us?

  • Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
  • No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title.
  • We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one.
  • Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP).
  • Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible.
  • Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together.


Process

  1. Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are.
  2. Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going.
  3. Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves.
  4. Meet the team in our Zurich office.
  5. A mutual decision, before we welcome you to the team.

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include:

  • Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working

  • Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews

  • Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage

 

As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer, you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo.

title: Commercial Director - Bern (m/f/d)
description:
Intro

Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 530 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Dich begeistert ein Mix aus strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und operativ-kommerzieller Optimierung und Du willst Deine wirtschaftliche Expertise bei einem dynamisch wachsenden Player der Augenheilkunde unter Beweis stellen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

In dieser Rolle wirst Du zur Führung und Optimierung der kaufmännischen Aktivitäten mehrerer Augenzentren in Bern die kaufmännische Geschäftsführung übernehmen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die strategische Überwachung, das Leistungsmanagement, die Teamführung und die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Dein Engagement für hervorragende Leistungen wird dazu beitragen, die Geschäftsziele zu erreichen, die Patientenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen und das Wachstum der Präsenz von Sanoptis in der Region zu fördern.


In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Unsere Augenzentren kaufmännisch leiten: Du wirst den Betrieb mehrerer Zentren wirtschaftlich leiten und dabei die Einhaltung der Sanoptis-Standards in den Einrichtungen sicherstellen.
  • Betriebsergebnisse und Geschäftsziele verantworten: Die betrieblichen Leistungskennzahlen zu Patientenzufriedenheit, Finanzindikatoren, Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Rentabilität wirst Du überwachen. Ferner wirst Du mit den Finanz- und Buchhaltungsteams bei der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Budgets, Finanzprognosen und Kostenkontrollmaßnahmen zusammenarbeiten.
  • Leistungsziele definieren: Du wirst Leistungsbewertungen durchführen und Ziele definieren. Es ist Dir ein wesentliches Anliegen, für Deine Mitarbeiter und Teams ein positives Arbeitsumfeld zu gewährleisten, das Leistung durch effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit fördert.
  • Die regionale Strategie planen: Die Formulierung regionaler, strategischer Pläne im Einklang mit unseren übergeordneten Geschäftszielen erarbeitest Du. Hierfür wirst Du eng mit dem Head of Operations sowie Ärzten und Fachkräften vor Ort arbeiten und netzwerken.
  • Wachstum durch Standortentwicklung vorantreiben: Du siehst Wachstumschancen in Deiner Region und erkennst sie frühzeitig, um sie gewinnbringend zu nutzen. Du wirst durch effektive Marketing- und Werbestrategien zur Steigerung des Patientenaufkommens in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam beitragen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen Ausbau des Marktanteils zu erreichen.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Einem starken Operationsteam, bestehend aus vielen Ex-Beratern (Bain, BCG, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman).

  • Renommierten Spezialisten und führenden Experten auf dem Gebiet der Augenheilkunde.
  • Einem engagierten und qualifizierten Team von medizinischen Fachkräften und Assistenzärzten.
  • Interdisziplinären Teams in unserem gesamten Netzwerk, einschließlich Technologieexperten, die an den neuesten Fortschritten in der augenmedizinischen Behandlung und digitalen Gesundheitslösungen arbeiten.


Dein Profil überzeugt durch

  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. in der Strategieberatung (McKinsey, Bain, BCG o.Ä.) oder in ähnlich schnelllebigen Unternehmen.
  • Die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Geschäfts- und Finanzanalysen auf Führungsebene zu erstellen und zu kommunizieren. Du erstellst Analysen akribisch und detailorientiert.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken mit der Fähigkeit, große Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Problemlösungen unabhängig voranzutreiben. Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit wenig Anleitung ist essenziell.
  • Nachgewiesene Erfolge im Umgang mit Interessensgruppen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen und Dir eine wichtige Rolle bei der Entscheidungsfindung zu sichern. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, auch in schwierigen Situationen Konflikte konstruktiv zu lösen und Durchsetzungsstärke zu behalten.
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Bereich Organisation und Prozessmanagement.
  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau), Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil sowie Englischkenntnisse.
  • Die Bereitschaft, Ergebnisse zu erzielen und Dich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit hoher Verantwortung zu entfalten.


Sanoptis bietet Dir

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein äußerst attraktives Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen, leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Leistungsziele gebunden ist.
  • Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, Dich zu beweisen, indem Du selbstständig arbeitest und eigene, innovative Ideen umfassend einbringst als Führungspersönlichkeit.
  • Berufliche Entwicklung: Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Wachstum und Karrierechancen bei guter Leistung, unterstützt durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen.

Gleiche Chancen

Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle.

title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

  • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it.

This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show.

What You'll Work On

  • Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00.

  • Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot.

  • Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it.

  • Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows.

  • Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate.

  • Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down.

Who We're Looking For

A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure.

Your Background

  • 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React.

  • Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels.

  • UI/UX practice: you design flows, prototype in Figma or similar, and run user tests.

  • Comfortable with backend APIs and real-time transport (WebSockets, WebRTC).

  • Accessibility and performance as habits, not afterthoughts.

Nice to Have

  • Control room, mission-critical or security interfaces.

  • Mapping and geospatial libraries (Mapbox, deck.gl or similar).

  • Building a design system from scratch.

  • Defence or regulated customers.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.
